sources.entry: dupeGuru - dupeGuru is a tool to find duplicate files on your computer. It can scan using file names and file contents.

summary.one_liner: dupeGuru is a cross-platform Qt/PyQt desktop GUI tool that finds duplicate files on a computer by file name or file contents.
summary.what_it_does: dupeGuru is a GUI application for locating duplicate files on a system, and the README describes it as cross-platform (Linux, OS X, Windows). It is written mostly in Python 3 and uses Qt for its user interface, with PyQt5 as a listed prerequisite. The Listed description says it can scan using file names and file contents. The source tree is split into a core logic package, a Qt UI package, images, packaging skeleton files, Sphinx help documentation, localization .po files, and a shared hscommon helper library. The README also covers building from source with make or with a plain virtualenv, generating Debian/Ubuntu packages, and running the test suite with tox or pytest. It has open calls for help with OS X maintenance, Linux packaging, translations, and documentation.
use_cases: find duplicate files on a computer
clean up duplicate photos or documents
scan folders for files with matching names or contents
package dupeGuru for Debian or Ubuntu
notable: Scans for duplicates by file name or by file contents
Cross-platform desktop GUI for Linux, OS X and Windows
Core logic separated from the Qt UI code in the source tree
Ships a makefile and build.py for building, plus Debian/Ubuntu packaging scripts
Includes localization .po files and Sphinx-built help docs
caveats: Maintainers say OS X and Linux packaging need more help, so those platforms may get less attention
Building requires Python 3.7+, PyQt5 and several system packages on Linux
Windows and macOS builds have separate instruction documents
